chunks: From him, from Abu Yusuf, from Al-Mitham, raising it, he said:

A man came to the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and said to him, 'I have married, so supplicate to Allah for me.' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Say, O Allah! By Your words I have permitted her, and by Your Security I have taken her. O Allah! Make her child-bearing, affectionate, not separating, consuming from what is comfortable, and not asking about what is not available.'

key_terms.اسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا: I have permitted her (referring to consummating the marriage)
key_terms.تَأْكُلُ مِمَّا رَاحَ: Consuming from what is comfortable/readily available

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication for a newly married man to recite according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the Prophetic tradition of invoking divine blessing at the consummation of marriage, emphasizing gratitude for the lawful union. The supplication specifically requests that the spouse be 'fertile and loving' (waluda wa-duda) and content with what is easily accessible, reflecting the Shia emphasis on marital harmony and simplicity. It serves as a practical model for couples to sanctify their physical intimacy through remembrance of Allah's covenant.

en.hubeali: From him, from Abu Yusuf, from Al Maysami, raising it, said,

‘A man came over to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup>, so he said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘I have got married, therefore supplicate to Allah<sup>azwj</sup> for me’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Say, ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! With Your<sup>azwj</sup> words I have permitted her, and with Your<sup>azwj</sup> Security I take her. O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Make her child-bearing, cordial, not separating, consuming from what is comfortable, and not asking about what is not available’.
en.sarwar: 4. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from abu Yusuf from al-Mithamiy in a marfu’ manner has said

the following: “Once, a man came to ’Amir al-Mu’minin, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and said, ‘I have just married, pray for me to Allah.’ He (the Imam) said, ’Say, 0 Lord, with Your words I have made her marriage lawful and in Your trust I have taken her (in marriage); O Lord, make her child-bearing, loving and not clashing in dislike, use what is found and not ask what to bring home (this and that).”’
